note: Annual totals rounded to $0.1 billion; CBO categories and interest rounded to $1 billion. Public-debt interest differs from broader net interest outlays. Figures do not establish the FY2027 year-to-date deficit. GDP denominator is Q3 annualized, not CBO FY2026 annual GDP; their published fiscal-year deficit ratio is 6.2%. In-game GDP remains fixed until an economic model exists. Tax receipts are CBO FY2026 values rounded to billions; 20% income is an invented model index, not a US tax rate. Implied fixed bases are approximations, not observed taxable income or causal estimates.
gdp_period: 2026 Q3 advance estimate, seasonally adjusted annual rate
